target: Paisaje funcional del Puente de Madera Ancha en el Camino de la Tierra Húmeda.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Paso importante para carros y peatones antes de los humedales; puente robusto y ordinario, integrado a una ruta que empieza a humedecerse.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Create a wide travel landscape centered on the canonical Puente de Madera Ancha. A broad, sturdy, weathered timber bridge carries a wagon-width dirt road across a modest watercourse before the true wetlands. Construction is practical, low and believable: heavy beams, simple rails only where needed, damp supports and wheel wear. Open Edran fields remain visible behind while taller wet grasses begin ahead. The bridge is infrastructure, not monumental architecture.
negative_constraints: No covered bridge, suspension bridge, stone viaduct or fantasy bridge
No ornate carvings, banners or cultural symbols
No settlement attached to the bridge
No magical water or dramatic golden lighting
No characters or creatures as focal subject
